_doc.purpose: Grandfather list for scripts/check-file-size.mjs, which turns the 2200-line max-lines rule in .oxlintrc.json into a blocking gate. JSON has no comments, so the documentation is this key.
_doc.counting: Lines in tracked non-test source files under src/, extensions/*/src and ui/src.
_doc.max: The line count each file was at when grandfathered. It is a ratchet: growing past max fails, shrinking below it warns so the max can be tightened, and reaching the limit makes the entry prunable.
_doc.status: This list is the modularization backlog; it should only shrink.
